family.name: pp_bracket
family.title: L-bracket under a tip load: displacement and von Mises across the design space
family.domain: structural / brackets and machine parts in linear elasticity

reference.name: immersed finite-element elasticity, plane stress-free 2-D, checked on equilibrium
reference.citation: pinneapple_simulation.immersed (Burman & Hansbo ghost-penalty finite cells; see docs/guides/immersed_analysis.md), verified against conforming FEM in immersed.verification and docs/guides/immersed_analysis.md
assumptions: linear, isotropic, small-strain elasticity in 2-D with Poisson ratio 0.33
the leg is a solid 2-D section: no out-of-plane bending, no plate or shell behaviour
the base edge is fully clamped, the load is a total force spread over the tip edge
the mesh is fixed at 1/50 of the longer leg, so a coarse-mesh error remains in every field

split.policy: random by geometry, fixed by the seed: a held-out body is never a training body

ensemble_spread.note: standard deviation between the bagged ensemble heads, not a confidence level

probes.name: a 4.5 m leg, 2.8x the trained arm
reasons: geometry 12.19x farther from the training designs than usual

probes.name: a 300 kN load, 10x the trained load
reasons: operating parameters [0] outside the trained range

ood.threshold: the library's own: geometry-code distance over the 95th percentile of the training nearest-neighbour distances, above 1.5x
ood.note: reported as measured: a probe the model does not flag is not thereby inside its validity domain

measured_here: held-out relative L2 0.8281 on 4 designs of 384 points, tolerance 0.05
constant-field baseline on the same designs: 0.8968
OOD: 2/2 probes outside the family flagged, 1/4 held-out designs flagged
not_measured: the reference itself: solver — immersed finite-element elasticity, plane stress-free 2-D, checked on equilibrium, with the assumptions it lists
agreement with a solver or with measured data for any geometry of this family
whether the ensemble spread is calibrated: it is the spread between bootstrap heads
behaviour outside the declared geometry and operating bounds of the family
